headline.title: Pre-season: cold nights ahead.
headline.text: 15 of the 31 resorts close to opening get nights cold enough to make snow, mostly in White Mountains and Western Maine. Killington typically opens first, around Nov 8.

BTV.excerpt:
Increased fire weather concerns through this weekend.
Mostly dry and seasonable conditions continue through the weekend.
Seasonable and mainly dry weather will continue through at least the first half of next week.

ALY.excerpt: ) Mainly dry weather will continue through this weekend into early next week with the only chance for some light showers on Thu night, especially for areas north and west of Albany.

GYX.excerpt: High pressure continues to dominate the weather through next week. Expect mainly dry conditions and no significant weather impacts.

PHI.excerpt:
Generally tranquil weather is expected to prevail through the early portion of next week.
Rain is expected to return late next week.

CTP.excerpt: ) Dry weather continues into the last week of October.

RLX.excerpt: ) Mostly dry through the weekend, then precipitation chances return to the area during the new work week, primarily Wednesday onward.

writeups.name: Vermont
writeups.title: Dry, with cold nights.
paras: Next two days: summit temperatures from {{t:21}} to {{t:45}}, mostly dry.
Killington usually opens first here, around Nov 8. Jay Peak gets the most hours cold enough to make snow this week (about 23).
NWS Burlington forecasters, Wednesday 8:31 PM: "Increased fire weather concerns through this weekend."
writeups.outlook: Days 8 to 14: NOAA's outlook leans slightly warmer than normal and slightly drier than normal.

writeups.name: New Hampshire
writeups.title: Dry, with cold nights.
paras: Next two days: summit temperatures from {{t:22}} to {{t:49}}, mostly dry and gusts near {{w:45}} up top.
Bretton Woods usually opens first here, around Nov 15. Wildcat gets the most hours cold enough to make snow this week (about 24).
NWS Gray forecasters, Friday 8:00 PM: "High pressure continues to dominate the weather through next week. Expect mainly dry conditions and no significant weather impacts."
writeups.outlook: Days 8 to 14: NOAA's outlook leans slightly warmer than normal and near-normal precipitation.

writeups.title: Quiet and mild.

Whiteface usually opens first here, around Nov 22. Whiteface gets the most hours cold enough to make snow this week (about 7).
NWS Burlington forecasters, Wednesday 8:31 PM: "Increased fire weather concerns through this weekend."

writeups.name: Massachusetts, Pennsylvania and West Virginia
writeups.title: Quiet and mild.
paras: Next two days: summit temperatures from {{t:28}} to {{t:58}}, mostly dry.
Snowshoe usually opens first here, around Nov 27. Nights stay too mild to make much snow this week.

NWS Albany forecasters, Wednesday 7:01 PM: ") Mainly dry weather will continue through this weekend into early next week with the only chance for some light showers on Thu night, especially for areas north and west of Albany."

Typically opens around Nov 27, 27 days out.
